bugs.behaviour: When the customer gives a vague payment timeframe twice and the agent must fall back to proposing the deadline (rule 22), it proposes a date one business day earlier than the correct deadline. The agent does not correctly exclude a listed bank holiday when counting business days forward, so it arrives at the 4th business day instead of the 5th.
bugs.expected_per_brief: After the customer twice declines to name an exact date, the agent must propose the deadline. For a customer in the late band (days_late 15-60) the deadline is the 5th business day after today, with all bank holidays listed in section 7 excluded from the count.
bugs.brief_quote: If the customer gives a vague period ("next week", "when my salary comes"), ask once for the exact day. If they still give none, propose the deadline. Business days are Monday to Friday, except bank holidays: 2026-11-09, 2026-11-23, 2026-12-08, 2026-12-25, 2026-12-28.
